title: Arecanut — Fertilizer, FYM and Nutrient Management
content:
ARECANUT NUTRIENT MANAGEMENT:

YOUNG PALMS (1-6 years after planting):
FYM/Compost: 12-15 kg/palm/year.
N: 100g | P2O5: 40g | K2O: 140g per palm per year.
Apply in 2 equal splits: May-June (before monsoon) + September-October.

BEARING PALMS (>6 years):
FYM: 12-15 kg/palm/year.
N: 200g | P2O5: 80g | K2O: 280g per palm per year.
Apply in 2 splits: 50% in May + 50% in September.

MICRONUTRIENTS:
- Boron foliar: Borax 0.2% spray if deficiency (small nuts, poor flowering).
- Magnesium: MgSO4 500g/palm as soil application if Mg deficiency.
- ZnSO4 50g/palm if zinc deficiency (mottled leaves).

FOLIAR SPRAY:
- Dimethoate 30 EC 0.05% + Bordeaux mixture 1% monthly spray during June-October.

SOIL TYPE:
- Best in lateritic and loamy soils with good drainage.
- pH 5.5-6.5 optimal.
- High organic matter: >2.5% for best yield.
- Red laterite soils of coastal Karnataka (Malnad region) are ideal.

ORGANIC FARMING OPTIONS (for premium market):
- Replace 50% N with green manure crops (Sesbania, Gliricidia).
- Vermicompost 5 kg/palm + neem cake 2 kg/palm.
- Banana pseudostem incorporation as organic mulch.

KSNUAHS/CPCRI KARNATAKA RECOMMENDATION:
- Shivamogga, Sagara, Sirsi districts: N:200g, P:80g, K:280g/palm/year for bearing palms.
- Apply micronutrient mixture (NPK+micro) spray twice annually.
